text: The project initially aimed to modernize Pakistan's hydrometeorological services to align with World Meteorological Organization standards, enhancing data quality and forecasting capabilities. It later pivoted towards nature-based solutions and crisis response, aligning with Pakistan's Nationally Determined Contributions and focusing on community resilience through ecosystem restoration and sustainable management. The project also supported legal and policy strengthening for disaster risk management.

metadata.solution_name: Pakistan Hydromet and Climate Services Project (PHCSP/PHSCP)
